name: NAADP binder domain-bait scan (PF17054 + PF09793/PF21166)
description: Candidate binder-family proteins from InterPro's Pfam protein lists. Note what this scan can and cannot do: it finds JPT-family and Lsm12-family proteins, which is NOT the same as finding NAADP binders — JPT1 carries the JPT signature and does not bind NAADP. A domain hit here is a family call, never a function call.
